name: Dependency-aware guided preflight
current_friction: Missing jsonschema becomes a fatal runtime failure
acceptance_criteria: No import traceback for missing dependency
Stable exit code and recovery text

name: Scope and control plan preview
current_friction: Selection and scope are resolved implicitly at execution
proposed_change: Add --plan with target, profile, controls, exclusions, and no-network guarantee
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic plan and out-of-scope negative tests

name: Stable versioned output schema
current_friction: SelectedControls is expected by tests but absent from emitted coverage
proposed_change: Version coverage fields and add compatibility aliases/migration
acceptance_criteria: Existing consumers and schema tests pass

name: Generated CLI/help reference
current_friction: README option table and parser can drift
proposed_change: Generate option docs and golden --help snapshot
acceptance_criteria: Every parser option appears once with default/applicability

name: Recovery-oriented error catalog
current_friction: Dependency, schema, scope, and incomplete-run errors have no unified code catalog
proposed_change: Stable error codes plus actionable next steps
acceptance_criteria: Every fatal path has code, guidance, and negative test

name: Accessible plain-text and HTML modes
current_friction: Rich HTML/CSV/JSON exists without explicit no-color/TTY/accessibility contract
proposed_change: No-color/plain mode, semantic headings, captions, keyboard-friendly details

name: Fixture tutorial and cleanup flow
current_friction: Self-check requires dependencies and nested output discovery
proposed_change: Tutorial runs fixture check, verifies manifest, prints run path, and cleans only its output
acceptance_criteria: Works from unrelated CWD in locked environment
